summary: Multi-day session: WhatsApp sidecar deployment, Telegram bot improvements, helpdesk data analysis, remote access via Tailscale.
what_was_done: WhatsApp sidecar: port 4100 conflict resolved, mutex fix, unused whatsmeow logger fixed, pure Go SQLite for session storage
Telegram: long message split, form collection (/laporan) with NIK/email validation, daily report (/daily), unanswered question tracking
Helpdesk: 5,816 questions extracted from WhatsApp ChatStorage.sqlite, filtered to 1,293 individual, user marked 1,125 [X], 134 remaining gaps identified
Remote access: Tailscale confirmed working (71ms ping via 5G), SSH and bridge reachable from outside network
System prompt refined: shorter answers, no markdown, precise responses
pending_for_next_session: User to fill answers for 134 remaining gap questions
Cross-reference gap questions against knowledge base to check coverage
Move pre-index script (scripts/preindex.mjs) to Mac for batch OCR
